author: Emma R.
title: Finally a pillow that fits how I sleep
body: I switch between my back and my side all night and this is the first pillow that works for both. The center cradle holds my head and the side wings fill the gap at my shoulder.

author: Daniel K.
title: Great for side sleeping
body: The side zones are the real selling point. My head stays level and my shoulder is not pinched anymore.

author: Sofia M.
title: Took a few nights to get used to
body: The shape feels different at first, and it took me about three nights to find the zone that suits me.
